name: feed-click-auc

role.auc: primary — the only objective the frontier ranks, and the number the gate compares against the baseline
role.logloss: diagnostic — recorded so a human can see calibration, never ranked
role.train_seconds: cost — recorded by the executor, never optimised
role.parameters: guardrail — a ceiling a structural change must not cross, not a thing to maximise

notes: The kernel reads `direction` and `objectives`; `role` is for people and for the dashboard.
`rounds.metric.direction` in config.json must agree with `direction` here (higher = up). If they disagree, `overview()` warns: two accounts of "better" make two rounds incomparable.
Changing either one is a configuration change, not a code change.
